title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30346: make InsertPostValueEntryToGL public in Item Jnl.-Post Line
summary: The InsertPostValueEntryToGL procedure in codeunit 22 Item Jnl.-Post Line is now public, allowing extensions to reuse the standard General Ledger posting logic for inventory variances.
key_points: InsertPostValueEntryToGL changed from local to public procedure
Extensions can now call standard value-entry-to-G/L posting logic
Change applied consistently across W1 and localized layers (APAC, CH, ES, IT, RU)
Enables extension authors to post additional variances using standard flows
Addresses extensibility request from external developers
